events.title: Mizzou Men's Basketball vs. Arkansas-Pine Bluff
events.addr: Mizzou Arena, University of Missouri, Columbia, MO
events.blurb: The Missouri Tigers host Arkansas-Pine Bluff in a Black Friday afternoon game at Mizzou Arena.
events.blurbEs: Los Missouri Tigers reciben a Arkansas-Pine Bluff en un partido la tarde del Black Friday en Mizzou Arena.

events.title: Mizzou Football vs. Oklahoma
events.addr: Faurot Field, University of Missouri, Columbia, MO
events.blurb: Missouri closes its regular season at home against Oklahoma. The SEC put it in the afternoon window (about 2:30–3:30 p.m.); check the schedule for the exact kickoff.
events.blurbEs: Missouri cierra su temporada regular en casa contra Oklahoma. La SEC lo programó en la franja de la tarde (aprox. 2:30–3:30 p.m.); consulta el calendario para la hora exacta.

events.title: MKT Trail
events.blurb: A 9-mile rail trail from downtown that links to the Katy Trail.
events.blurbEs: Una vía verde de 14 km desde el centro que conecta con el Katy Trail.

events.title: Shelter Gardens
events.blurb: A five-acre garden with a pond and a one-room schoolhouse.
events.blurbEs: Un jardín de dos hectáreas con estanque y una escuela de un solo salón.
